description: The shortest chain of links between 2 entities of Atlas, in either direction, and the counterparties that they share (the banks that lend to both, the customers of both, a common owner), each link with its summary, evidence and document ids. By default an entity of a covered group stands as its group, so that 2 banks of one group count as one lender.

from.description: entity id from search_entities, for example boeing

group.description: draw an entity of a covered group as its group (default true)

kinds.description: kinds of link to follow (default every kind)

to.description: entity id from search_entities, for example caterpillar

name: find_connections
title: Find the connections of 2 entities
